{{Quote|It is the heart of our planet, and the center of our worship.|Fumiyo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 99">[[Star Wars (1977) 99|''Star Wars'' (1977) 99]]</ref>}}
The '''House of the Goddess''' was a large structure on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Godo]]. It was the main place of worship for the native [[Godoan/Legends|Godoans]] and housed the [[Dancing Goddess/Legends|Dancing Goddess]] and [[Minstrel]] statues. [[Fumiyo]] took [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], [[Bey]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to visit the temple when they were investigating the [[Godoan's disease|virus]] that was afflicting the Godoans. Upon closer inspection, C-3PO and R2-D2 discovered that the building was a "techno-organic construct", a machine of sorts. When the group were at the House, they found that the two statues were missing; thus causing the virus across the planet. Han and Luke retrieved the Minstrel while [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and Chewbacca retrieved the Dancing Goddess. When both of the statues were replaced in the House, the machine began to function again and the red fumes in the atmosphere that caused the virus were dissipated.
